pick.name: Claude API (Claude Console) funded by Max API credits
pick.what: Anthropic first-party Messages API, structured outputs, tool use, computer use, Agent SDK; Max 5x/20x subscribers get monthly API credits
pick.why: Best model quality for agents/healthcare reasoning, typed SDKs Claude Code knows best, BAA path exists, and Max credits cover prototype spend at $0 cash
pick.free_limits: Doc wording: 'Claude Max and Team plans include monthly credits for the Claude API.' Max 5x $100 USD/mo, Max 20x $200 USD/mo (Team: $20/Standard seat, $100/Premium seat, pooled, capped $500). Covers Claude API, Managed Agents, Agent SDK, Console playground; NOT Claude Code, NOT extra usage in Claude apps, NOT Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry. Expires end of each billing cycle, no rollover. New subscribers claim after 7 days by linking one Console org (cannot be changed without support). No payment method needed. Credits count toward org monthly spend cap. When exhausted, requests fail until next credits (never billed to plan). Prices per MTok in/out: Haiku 5.5 $0.10/$0.50, Sonnet 5.5 $2/$10, Opus 5.5 $4/$20, Opus 5 $5/$25, Fable 5.1 $10/$50; Batch -50%.
pick.maintained: Pricing page lists Fable 5.1, Sonnet 5.5, Haiku 5.5 (seen 2026-10-28); @anthropic-ai/sdk 1.3.0 on 2026-10-23; anthropic (PyPI) 2.3.0 on 2026-10-23
pick.commercial_ok: yes (credits are spent by your own Console org under Anthropic Commercial Terms, which allow powering products for your own customers (s.A.1); credits cannot be transferred or sold (credit terms B.2); reselling raw API access barred (s.D.4))

decision: Use the Console org funded by Max credits for all dev/prototype and early customer traffic; route routine calls to Haiku 5.5 ($0.10/$0.50) and keep Sonnet/Opus for hard steps. Switch to Bedrock/Vertex only if a buyer demands it. For PHI the Primary Owner signs the BAA and then asks Anthropic to enable PHI use.
details: Claim: claude.ai Settings > Billing > API credits > link Console org. Credits are monthly use-it-or-lose-it; customer traffic beyond $100-200/mo needs purchased credits. BAA source (opened): https://privacy.claude.com/en/articles/8114513-business-associate-agreements-baa-for-commercial-customers - covered models need 30-day retention, Batch/Files API not covered. Never put PHI in structured-output schemas (cached 24h).

verify.note: Credit amounts/coverage/expiry/one-org link confirmed on official doc. commercial_ok is not 'unclear': credits fund your own Console org's API usage ('build and run your own applications and agents'); Commercial Terms A.1 allow powering products for your own customers; only transfer/resale of credits (credit terms B.2) and resale of the Services (D.4) are barred.
